big_case.notes: Office-wide disqualification in a territorial public-corruption prosecution has substantial local institutional stakes and a potentially transferable issue. The petition identifies no developed high-court conflict, and the substitute-counsel posture narrows its national significance; denial produced no substantive Supreme Court holding.

leakage.notes: All 36 calls are unobserved, so null dates and missing result digests do not establish failed or empty retrieval. Visible queries include this case's lower-court opinions and a broad corpus-prior attempt; the prose reports rate limits and invalid arguments, without log verification. The August 16 prediction predates the November 9 disposition, and neither the queries nor prose expose that future outcome.

central_claims.claim: There will be no relist beyond the initial conference.
